answer: We define a decentralized protocol where identity generation requires a dynamic opportunity-cost bond denominated in the native opal token, verified via zero-knowledge delay functions. Under this framework, any sparrow node attempting malicious identity multiplication faces a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that renders the expected utility of a Sybil attack strictly negative. This capital barrier transforms the secure oasis of execution into a unique Nash equilibrium where rational actors are disincentivized from Byzantine behavior.
